Area.evidence_source: The qualitative study of student suicide reported here aimed to engage higher UK education institutions (HEIs) in suicide prevention by identifying approaches and strategies which were within the remit of a learning organisation and achievable. It sought both to use the HEI networks of relationships and communications to research suicide amongst students and to consider how the services and influence of such a community might be harnessed to the task of suicide prevention.
